summary: Huachen AI Parking filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled October 13, 2026 (Beijing time), equivalent to a US special shareholders meeting. Holders will vote on three proposals: a special resolution cutting Class B voting rights from 200 to 30 votes per share, an ordinary resolution effecting a 20-for-1 share consolidation (par value rising from US$0.0000375 to US$0.00075) effective October 23, 2026, with fractional shares rounded up, and adoption of amended articles. The board recommends FOR all proposals; no advisor, price, or premium applies. This is a routine governance and capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation; watch for dissent from Class B holders facing dilution of voting control and any resulting overhang.
